name: What is the typical timeline for an interior painting project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for an interior painting project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an interior painting project depends on its scope. A single room might take 1-3 days, including prep and drying times. A multi-room or entire home project can range from one to two weeks, sometimes more for larger homes or complex designs. Factors like surface condition, the number of coats, and drying conditions influence the timeline. A reliable contractor will provide a clear project schedule after assessing the work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary; a single room may take 1-3 days, while a whole home can be 1-2 weeks or more. It depends on scope, condition, and paint coats.
